name: comp-185
title: Pill Switch With Text
blurb: Pill switch with sliding Off/On text labels inside.
description: Pill-style switch with Off/On text labels that slide in and out based on state.
use_when: When explicit state labels help users understand the switch without ambiguity.
avoid_when: When space is very limited or when the context makes labels unnecessary.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with sr-only label and sliding text that appears/disappears.
